faq_heading: Homes near Ocean Cliff Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Ocean Cliff Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Ocean Cliff Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Ocean Cliff Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Ocean Cliff Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 68 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,713,000, townhomes $810,000, condos $1,237,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Ocean Cliff Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Ocean Cliff Elementary the median was 24 days on the market, closing at 96.9% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 68 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Ocean Cliff Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Crescent Park Elementary (1.1 km north-east), Laronde Elementary (1.2 km east) and Elgin Park Secondary (2.1 km north-east).

Ocean Cliff Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 12550 20 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Intensive French (6-7).
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Ocean Cliff Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Ocean Cliff Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Ocean Cliff Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Ocean Cliff Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 68 homes sold within 1 km of Ocean Cliff Elementary: 48 houses, 9 townhomes and 10 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,713,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Ocean Cliff Elementary

5 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Ocean Cliff Elementary in a straight line (4 elementary, 1 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Crescent Park Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Chantrell Creek Elementary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Elgin Park Secondary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Crescent Park Elementary (1.1 km north-east), Laronde Elementary (1.2 km east), Ray Shepherd Elementary (2.3 km east), Chantrell Creek Elementary (2.6 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Crescent Park Elementary, 1.1 km north-east of Ocean Cliff Elementary.
